title: Big News!
excerptHtml: We are excited to announce that as of January 1, 2019 Wood Christian Counseling has changed its name and will now be The Bridge Therapeutic Services, PLLC. We will still provide everything you have loved about Wood Christian Counseling, and we are expanding our services to offer whole health care! Our office location and phone number will remain the same.
